import json, re

with open("/home/ubuntu/.claude-account-3/projects/-home-ubuntu--agent-ml-research-idea-gen-0509-8-projects-acr-vla-conformal-refinement/642a4adf-826a-4a7c-97dc-f63002a556c7/tool-results/mcp-agent-ml-research-read_registry-1779938287990.txt", "r") as f:
    raw = f.read()

outer = json.loads(raw)
registry = json.loads(outer["result"])
experiments = registry["data"]["experiments"]

# New style patterns:
# eval-obs-object-normXXX-sYY  (no "only" in name)
# eval-obs-object-normXXX-sYY-westd
# eval-obs-object-normXXX-sYY-bjb2
# eval-perdof-object-normXXX-sYY-v3
# eval-perdof-object-normXXX-sYY-westd

# These are K=2 adaptive conformal CRM, with SR in 70-80% range
# Old style: eval-obs-only-object-normXXX-seedYY (K=10 reconvla, SR ~10-20%)

new_style_obs = re.compile(r'^eval-obs-object-norm(\d+)-s(\d+)(-.*)?$')
new_style_perdof = re.compile(r'^eval-perdof-object-norm(\d+)-s(\d+)(-.*)?$')

results = {"obs_norm003": [], "obs_norm005": [], "perdof_norm003": [], "perdof_norm005": []}

for eid, e in sorted(experiments.items()):
    if e.get("status") != "DONE" or e.get("conclusion") != "success":
        continue
    
    m_obs = new_style_obs.match(eid)
    m_perdof = new_style_perdof.match(eid)
    
    if m_obs:
        norm = m_obs.group(1)
        seed = m_obs.group(2)
        suffix = m_obs.group(3) or ""
        if norm == "003":
            results["obs_norm003"].append(eid)
        elif norm == "005":
            results["obs_norm005"].append(eid)
    elif m_perdof:
        norm = m_perdof.group(1)
        seed = m_perdof.group(2)
        suffix = m_perdof.group(3) or ""
        if norm == "003":
            results["perdof_norm003"].append(eid)
        elif norm == "005":
            results["perdof_norm005"].append(eid)

# Now print full details for each group
for group_name, eids in results.items():
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"GROUP: {group_name}")
    print(f"{'='*80}")
    for eid in eids:
        e = experiments[eid]
        server = e.get("server", "UNKNOWN")
        metrics = e.get("metrics", {})
        spec = e.get("spec", {})
        command = spec.get("command", "NO COMMAND")
        
        # Flag westd
        is_westd = "westd" in eid or "westd" in str(server)
        flag = " *** WESTD BIAS ***" if is_westd else ""
        
        # Extract SR
        sr = metrics.get("success_rate", metrics.get("overall_sr", metrics.get("SR", metrics.get("overall_success_rate", "N/A"))))
        
        print(f"\n  exp_id: {eid}{flag}")
        print(f"  server: {server}")
        print(f"  SR: {sr}")
        print(f"  metrics: {json.dumps(metrics)[:300]}")
        print(f"  command: {command[:500]}")
    print(f"\n  Count: {len(eids)}")
